# Open Arms LLC

> > Trauma-informed childcare and micro school programs with online booking for therapy, speech therapy, and early childhood education services.

Open Arms LLC provides specialized childcare and educational services with a focus on trauma-informed practices. The organization operates programs including the Open Arms Micro School Program and partners with providers like Abundant Love Child Care Center to deliver comprehensive child development and therapeutic services.

## Key Topics

- Trauma-Informed Care
- Micro School Programs
- Speech Therapy
- Childcare Services
- Therapy Sessions
- Early Childhood Education
- Small Class Programs
- Child Development
- Service Booking
- Abundant Love Child Care Center
- Pathways to Stability
- Scheduling
- WCAG Accessibility
- Therapy-Education Integration

- [Home](https://www.openarmsopenwide.com): Open Arms LLC homepage featuring trauma-informed childcare and micro school programs
